name: Grounded AI that advances people's goals
vision_statement: Goals keep moving between a person's sessions, because the work they delegated gets done to the standard they wrote, and every answer and action rests on the person's own goals, material and preferences, and never on another person's.
opportunities: Other products that need an AI which works from a person's own goals and material could reuse this engine, so the grounding, the standard for delegated work and the scope fences are built once and shared.
solution_coherence: quest-ai-runner turns a person's request or queued task into grounded work in one loop, and do-grounded-work is that loop. It asks the model through call-a-model, works in the person's Quest account through access-quest-operations and takes in requests through take-in-the-world. It reasons step by step through reason-and-answer, recalls what a request needs through remember-and-recall and acts on the account through act-as-the-body. It holds its work to the metric that serves it through think-critically, has every run watched through watch-for-risk and keeps the long view across turns through hold-the-intents. It stays comparable by metric through keep-it-generic and answers questions about the world through know-the-world. remember-and-recall recalls the cards that match a request through card-store. call-a-model accounts for every call through justify-model-calls and track-usage-and-cost. reason-and-answer sends the prompt of each step to the model through call-a-model. watch-for-risk has the model oversee a run through call-a-model. run-queued-tasks claims, runs and reports a queued task, asking the model through call-a-model and working in the account through access-quest-operations. act-as-the-body reads and changes the quest through persist-cards, access-quest-operations and run-queued-tasks. hold-the-intents saves what it learned through persist-cards. take-in-the-world hears from a live channel through talk-over-a-channel.
